news.headline: Abivax S.A. (ABVX) investors report 6.0% beneficial stake via Invus entities
Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax said the FDA provided constructive feedback and aligned with the company on the planned content and format of its NDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, keeping the company on track to submit by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Abivax price target to $180 from $132, keeps Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a bullish stance on Abivax and lifted its price target sharply, citing confidence in the obefazimod maintenance data and the company's strengthened cash position and commercial buildout.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders (heads of marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations, and market access) as it builds out the US organization ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and potential obefazimod launch.

news.headline: Abivax reportedly re-engages Centerview amid renewed takeover interest
news.source: La Lettre (reported via TipRanks/The Fly and other outlets)
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported that Abivax has re-engaged advisor Centerview as takeover interest in the company resurfaced, keeping M&A speculation alive even after the company's large capital raise reduced its near-term need for a partner.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its upsized public offering after underwriters fully exercised their option, bringing gross proceeds to $920 million (about $874 million net); the company said this funds operations into Q4 2029 and supports a potential solo US launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod
news.summary: Supplemental Part 2 data showed 50 mg obefazimod produced meaningful clinical benefit in induction non-responders with prior advanced-therapy failure, with 37.2% achieving clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44, strengthening the Phase 3 maintenance safety database.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax is scheduled to report first-half 2026 financial results, which should give an updated cash-runway and commercial-buildout progress picture.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod NDA submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: Following the positive July 30, 2026 pre-NDA meeting, Abivax targets submitting its first NDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: Takeover / M&A speculation
catalysts.detail: Persistent buyout chatter continues with advisor Centerview reportedly re-engaged (per La Lettre, July 17, 2026); no confirmed deal or timeline exists, and management has emphasized an independent path after the $920M raise.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval / US commercial launch
catalysts.detail: Contingent on NDA acceptance and standard/priority review following the end-2026 filing; Abivax is actively building its US commercial organization in preparation.

pulse: Momentum remains strongly positive: Abivax closed a $920M offering in early July, secured a positive FDA pre-NDA meeting on obefazimod on July 30, and is staffing up a US commercial team, with Morgan Stanley lifting its price target to $180 on the back of the maintenance data. Takeover speculation persists (Centerview reportedly re-engaged mid-July) even as management signals growing confidence in an independent US launch path. The next hard catalyst is the September 21, 2026 H1 results, with the end-of-2026 NDA submission as the key regulatory milestone ahead.
